title: BatchIdeasConfig
description: Array of 20 video topics for overnight batch creation

id.description: Unique identifier for the topic (e.g. topic_01)

type.description: Short type: 'deepdive' (1 pair, <=35s max) or 'compilation' (up to 3 pairs)

script.description: Script text narration for Google Gemini TTS generation

labels.description: Title labels for left/right comparison topics

assets_dir.description: Custom path to topic image assets (defaults to batch_input/{id}/)

audio_file.description: Optional pre-recorded audio file path (skips TTS if specified)
